comparison.objective: Relocate a target bar to a pad without dropping the loose reflector ball resting on it.
comparison.physical_skill: Careful transport of a coupled but unsecured object pair.
comparison.success_condition: Bar reaches the white pad with the silver ball still resting on top; numeric pose and stability thresholds are absent.
comparison.reason: The central skill is disturbance-minimizing transport, not intentional fracture followed by search and collection of released pieces.
